gate_findings.evidence: Task khai required_gates=[] va claim_ceiling=IDEA, nen khong co physics gate bat buoc. Reviewer van xac minh nen design basis: docs/design_basis/frame_f1_basis.json len solver_version frame-f1/0.3.0, guard cu max_reduced_condition_number va inactive_row_relative_tolerance da bi thay bang max_scaled_condition_number=1e12, loaded_unmodeled_dof_relative_tolerance=1e-12 va max_translation_to_characteristic_length=0.05. explicit_limitations khai trung thuc rang condition_number thuoc ma tran da phi thu nguyen hoa bang nghich dao chieu dai dac trung chu khong phai ma tran tho, va rang nguong 0.05 la bien applicability nghien cuu chu khong phai gioi han su dung theo tieu chuan. 5/5 artifact tu bam lai khop handoff r003.

Pham vi danh gia: equilibrium/reactions, benchmark giai tich, phat hien co cau, dieu kien so, solver version va hash, va khong con canh bao so chua xu ly. Hoi quy hoi tu 100 phan tram. Finding HIGH cua r002 (cond Jacobi mu voi suy bien nam tren duong cheo) da bit dung cach: unit_scale chia rieng DOF xoay cho characteristic_length (frame_f1.py:521-525) thay vi chia cho can bac hai duong cheo, nen giu duoc tuong phan do cung. Do doc lap tren V-truss N1(0,0)-N2(5,h)-N3(10,0), hai dau co dinh, Fy=-10 kN tai N2: h=0.5 cond=1.000000e+02 CONVERGED; h=0.05 cond=1.000000e+04 CONVERGED; h=0.005 cond=1.000000e+06 MODEL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED voi F1-SMALL-DISPLACEMENT=FAIL; h=5e-6 cond=1.000000e+12 MODEL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED voi F1-SMALL-DISPLACEMENT=FAIL. r002 cho cond=1.000000e+00 khong doi o ca bon va gan CONVERGED voi toan bo check PASS. Khong ca nao con CONVERGED-toan-PASS. De co lap tac dung cua cond khoi guard chuyen vi, toi tang A de giu ty so chuyen vi ~1.25e-4 va CONVERGED: cond van di 1e2 -> 1e4 -> 1e6 -> 1e8 khi h giam, chung to check co rang that chu khong bi F1-SMALL-DISPLACEMENT che. Bat bien dong dang hinh hoc o scale 0.01, 1 va 100 voi A->s^2A va I->s^4I: console phang cond=1.267591879244e+04 giong het ba lan; V-truss cond=1.000000000000e+04 giong het ba lan. Ca hai yeu cau bat bien theo ti le VA nhay voi gan-co-cau nay cung dung. Co cau khong doi: B2 toan cuc va B cuc bo deu UNSTABLE_MODEL/F1-STABILITY FAIL; tan cong tam giac truss thieu goi (moi duong cheo deu duong nen guard duong cheo khong the bat) bi kiem hang bat o rank=3, doi chung chan du goi CONVERGED bay check PASS. Benchmark tu tinh trung nghiem dong: thanh keo 1.2500000000e-04, console v -4.1666666667e-03 va rz -6.2500000000e-04, dam gian don -2.6041666667e-02, phan luc 12.5/12.5. Provenance: solver_source_digests khop bytes that toi tu bam lai; chep source ra thu muc tam roi them mot dong thi hash doi (ec88e1a1 -> 3066ace0). Toan ven: validate_frame_result tai tinh result_sha256 tren toan payload nen chan het chin phep gia mao gom lat F1-SMALL-DISPLACEMENT FAIL->PASS va doi MODEL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED->CONVERGED. Schema: 0 lan feasible/verified/design_pass, additionalProperties:false o 11 cho, MODEL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED co trong enum, claim_level=IDEA, design_verdict_authority=NONE. Cac muc G2 khong danh gia vi ngoai pham vi F1: mesh convergence, element suitability ngoai 2D tuyen tinh, va doi chieu solver doc lap.
